rights.note: Adapted from Computer Networks: A Systems Approach by Larry Peterson and Bruce Davie, https://github.com/SystemsApproach/book, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: the chapter is condensed and rewritten for a general audience as short interactive cards; its examples and figures are kept (the 17-message click, the 25 MB image, the 1 MB file at 1 Gbps, the delay x bandwidth table) and redrawn in our own art; the sockets section is left out. The uncompressed-video figure of 75 Mbps is not used, since the chapter's own numbers give about 60 Mbps. Attribution is shown on the cover of every lesson and on the book home.

ideas.name: Building a network
ideas.can: Describe how links, switches and routers build an internet, why it shares links by packet, how layers wrap a message, and when latency matters more than bandwidth.
